name: Work Admission
definition: Accepts a unit of work from a system or an agent inside the platform, and refuses a unit that does not meet the contract.
rationale: DEC-031 states the contract for a unit of work on both sides, in the shape that DEC-014 set for a write to life state. FUN-ST-01 keeps admission apart from custody for the same reason: every caller observes what the system refuses, and no caller observes what it holds.

name: Work Custody
definition: Holds each unit of work with the agent responsible for it, the agent or the system that raised it, the work that caused it, and its state. Holds it when the platform restarts and when no client is attached. Closes a unit of work.
rationale: REQ-PL-007 continues work when no client is connected. DEC-005 makes one model for work and makes the state carry the difference between work that waits for a person and work that stopped. DEC-026 makes the agent that raised a unit different from the agent responsible for it, so the system holds both.

name: Work Visibility
definition: Gives the agent responsible and the current state of any unit of work that it holds, gives every unit of work that was raised under a given unit, and gives the result that the agent responsible stated when it closed a unit.
rationale: REQ-PL-007 gives the agent responsible and the current state. A task that many agents do over a long time is one unit with the units that it caused beneath it, and a caller cannot follow it without the set. REQ-PL-005 lets an agent get an answer from another agent, and DEC-005 makes that ask a unit of work, so the answer is the result of a unit that closed and not a second mechanism.

name: Work Direction
definition: Sends a unit of work to the agent that the unit names, including when no client is attached, sends a unit that names no agent to one declared agent, and bounds how much work runs at one time.
rationale: REQ-PL-005 directs work to agents in a declared hierarchy. DEC-030 gives this system no judgement, so the unit names its agent and the system does not choose one. The autonomous runtime of DEC-001 is stated as what a caller observes and not as the mechanism, under MET-005.

name: Admission by Position
definition: Refuses work, and refuses a request, that the position of the agent does not admit.
rationale: DEC-019 declares the position in one place and makes each boundary refuse. DEC-029 states that a position admits a part of life state and a set of acts.

name: Contention
definition: Detects two agents that want one declared resource.
rationale: Dropped by DEC-059. REQ-PL-006 made the platform detect contention and this function held the capability. Ownership removes the condition, so there is no contention to detect and no capability left here. OPN-054.

name: Resource Declaration
definition: Holds the declared resources and the owner of each, and accepts the declaration of a resource.
rationale: DEC-059 gives each declared resource one owner, and nothing else in the model declares a resource. FUN-ST-10 holds the kinds that State Custody accepts for the same reason, so this creates no fifth body under DEC-024. The owner is a position, which Agent Definition declares, so this function holds which position owns each resource and does not declare that position.
